The statement asks which possibility is a product risk. Incorrect tax in an invoice affects product functional correctness. Staff loss, late environment and supplier delay threaten project delivery/resources. The present-tense invoice example is scoped as a possible event, not a confirmed existing defect; invoice calculates is shorthand for invoicing functionality, not a physical paper calculating. Project risks can indirectly affect product quality without changing the primary classification of these offered examples.

Underestimating maintenance effort for automated scripts is a risk, unlike reduced repetitive work, greater repeatability and useful automated metrics, which are potential benefits. Maintenance effort itself is an expected cost; underestimating it creates planning/budget/sustainability risk. Benefits are not guaranteed, but alternative unforeseen costs do not reverse the requested risk-versus-benefit polarity.
